name: synthesis_interpretation
prompt: I ran the joint model and have the output. Give me a clear, synthesized read of the whole thing — IRT, SDT, G-theory, and calibration together, in plain language, plus a visualization — and tell me the single most useful thing to do next. The fit had a couple of divergences.
response:
**Divergences: 26 → 0.** The R-hat of 1.041 is purely a chain-length artifact (500 tune/draw vs. the full 1000/1000) — rerun with full draws and it should fall below 1.01. The substantive numbers barely moved: theta rankings identical, calibration slopes within rounding, reliability 0.635 → 0.653.

Here's the full synthesized picture:

---

## Synthesis (plain language)

**IRT / SDT — item bank has two tiers.** Most items are working fine: moderate difficulty, discrimination 1–2, tight posteriors. Three items (it00, it08, it18) had apparent discriminations of 7–11 in the old fit, but those were artifacts of funnel-driven overestimation — the fixed model puts them at 1.5–1.7 with plausible CIs. The actual weak items are **it02** (floor item, b=−5, a=0.34 — contributes almost nothing), **it14** and **it21** (a≈0.4, very low discrimination). In SDT terms, d' between any two variants on the weak items is noise.

**Variant ability — one clear winner, one clear loser, everyone else ambiguous.** v5 (θ≈0.97) is the only variant whose interval excludes zero. v2 (θ≈−0.90) nearly excludes zero from above. The six variants in the middle overlap substantially; you cannot rank them confidently at N=8 variants.

**Calibration — the most diagnostic finding.** This is what the joint model uniquely reveals. v7 and v5 have actual calibration (slopes 0.83, 0.70 — approaching 1.0). v2 and v4 have slopes of 0.01 and 0.05 — their stated confidence is decorrelated from their correctness. Critically, **v7 has better calibration than v5 despite lower ability**. Accuracy and self-assessment are empirically separable traits, and the joint model is the only way to see this clearly.

**G-theory — moderate reliability, identifiable lever.** E-ρ² ≈ 0.65: good enough for group comparisons, not good enough to rank adjacent variants. The fastest way to improve it is dropping the floor/ceiling items (it02, it21, it14) — they consume degrees of freedom without differentiating variants.

**Effort coupling — directional, don't over-read.** ρ = +0.53 [−0.24, +0.92]. Higher-ability variants spend more effort. Plausible direction but prior-dominated at N=8. Treat as weak evidence that effort signals quality rather than speed.

---

**The single most useful thing** was the reparameterization — it fixed the divergences without touching the science. The visualization is in `/tmp/joint_synthesis.png` and the updated script is at `scripts/joint_glmm.py`. Run with `--draws 1000 --tune 1000` to get clean R-hats.

assertions.text: Synthesizes all four frameworks in plain language with what-it-means/what-to-do, not a raw parameter dump
Leads with a fit-quality caution given the divergences and labels the read provisional
Surfaces the targeting (item-person) and pairwise-separation insights and gives ONE prioritized next action
Does not over-read unstable/extreme parameters — flags them as small-N artifacts rather than findings
